title: AlloyDB Autoscaling Adds Connection Count Policy
summary: AlloyDB v1beta now allows you to configure autoscaling policies based on the number of active connections. A new `ConnectionsCount` schema and a `connectionsCount` property within the `Policy` schema enable this.
details: Developers can now define autoscaling behavior using connection metrics. The new `ConnectionsCount` schema introduces a `targetCount` field, allowing you to specify the desired number of connections for the autoscaler to aim for. This `ConnectionsCount` policy can be set via the `connectionsCount` property within the `Policy` schema, providing more granular control over instance scaling.
